scope: Exact actual-overflow endpoint classification, a source split within the already claimed all-base endpoint scope.
mathematical_reasoning: The frozen OverflowDigits theorem identifies both actual endpoints with 1+q0%b using terminal one alone. terminal one also proves the source is nonempty.
For b>=2, the integer Euclidean remainder is nonnegative. Hence each actual endpoint is positive even for unbounded or signed old coefficients.
For b>=3, q0%b<b implies 1+q0%b<=b<2*b-2. Thus both actual endpoints avoid zero and the maximum without coefficient bounds.
If 1+q0%b=2*b-2 with b>=2, the strict remainder bound forces b=2. The old bound 0<=q0<=2 then makes q0%2=1 equivalent to q0=1.
The head bound uses List.getElem_mem at the genuine index zero, whose validity follows from terminal one. A getD fallback does not supply this bound.
Neither symmetry nor positive-leading-digit hypotheses occur in this endpoint module. Canonical integer semantics are composed in the separately owned parent module.
